propositions: recheck-review currently refuses all current-revision findings regardless of type, but bugfix-size-attestation findings can be resolved by writing a plan to the ticket and running rebar review-plan, not by code changes
when a bugfix-size-attestation finding is the only blocking issue and a valid plan-review attestation is earned, recheck-review should accept the request rather than force unnecessary code churn
the retrigger path must verify eligibility solely from the bot's own vote message and the ticket store, never from the requesting comment, to preserve the security invariant

recheck-review should accept only when the block is exactly bugfix-size-attestation (header count = 1), the ticket attestation buckets as accepted (certified, stale-code, or stale-head), and the ticket id is resolved from the commit message
recheck-review must refuse blocks containing bugfix-size-attestation mixed with other findings, attestations in FLAG_VERDICTS or infra states, and any parse failure or unresolvable state
